innovation_groups.title: Innovation groups: where innovation starts.
innovation_groups.text: In twelve topic groups, firms, researchers and startups meet twice a year, often at a member's site. They share problems, test ideas and start joint projects, with our help on partners and funding.
innovation_groups.guest_note: Not a member yet? Join twice as a guest, free of charge.

market.heading: Test the market before you invest

rules.label: Am I allowed to sell this?
rules.heading: Clear regulatory questions early

ig.title: Innovation groups
ig.line: Meet the companies and researchers working on your problem, in twelve topic groups that turn shared challenges into joint projects.
ig.blurb: Twelve groups, from insects to coffee, bring firms, research and startups to one table twice a year, often at a member's site. They share problems, test ideas and start joint projects. More than 1'000 participants a year.

coach.title: 1:1 coaching
coach.line: A neutral expert who sharpens your innovation question and leaves you with clear next steps, contacts and funding options. Open to non-members too.
coach.blurb: One-to-one sessions on trends, resilient processes, innovation strategy and funding. Each ends with clear next steps. Non-members can book too; members get better terms.
coach.financing: Further coaching can be financed through Ahead (canton of Zurich) or Innosuisse innovation mentoring.

booster.title: Innovation Booster Future Food Farming
booster.line: Up to CHF 39'000 and coaching to test a radical idea.
booster.audience: Any organisation with an implementation and a research partner
booster.blurb: The Innosuisse programme Swiss Food Research runs. Selected teams get up to CHF 39'000 and coaching. 28 projects funded so far.

funding.title: Funding support with proposal review
funding.line: Over 100 funding instruments in Switzerland: we find the one that fits, sharpen your project and review your proposal in confidence.
funding.blurb: Switzerland has more than 100 funding instruments, from Innosuisse to the Federal Office for Agriculture and cantonal programmes. We guide you in three steps up to submission.
steps: We find the instrument that fits your project.
We sharpen the project and look for research and industry partners.
We read your proposal like an evaluation panel and give written feedback. Confidential: the non-disclosure agreement is part of your membership.

novel.title: Novel food check
novel.line: Find out early whether your food needs novel food approval.
novel.blurb: We check your food with our own AI tool against EU Regulation 2015/2283 and Swiss law, and prepare the consultation if needed.

farm.title: Support for farmers
farm.line: Confidential support from farm idea to funded project.
farm.blurb: A first visit on the farm clarifies problem, solution, partners and funding. We sign a confidentiality agreement and stay with you until the project runs.

radicle.title: Radicle
radicle.line: Switzerland's agro-food wiki: over 6'500 projects from 50 years. Who researches what, who fits as a partner.
radicle.blurb: Radicle gathers research and innovation projects from public sources such as ARAMIS, the Swiss National Science Foundation and Regiosuisse, and prepares them with artificial intelligence: more than 6'500 projects from the last 50 years, updated every quarter. Find out in minutes who works on your topic, what has been funded and who would make a good partner. Use it in the web portal or directly in Claude. A project of the Federal Office for Agriculture, implemented by Swiss Food Research.

maas.title: MaaS: Market Validation as a Service
maas.line: Go, pivot or stop before the first production run.
maas.audience: Founders and firms; also for grant proposals and due diligence
maas.blurb: Will customers buy your product at your price? From a short brief, we simulate about 300 customer interviews across three market scenarios, grounded in Swiss prices, incomes and diets.
maas.when: When: before you build or produce anything, or to pre-check a grant proposal.
steps: You submit a brief: problem, customers, price and your own success criteria.
We add Swiss market data: comparable products, incomes, allergies.
About 300 personas are interviewed; four independent reviewers check the analysis.
You get a target segment, willingness to pay, five hypotheses for field tests and matching experts.

r2m.title: Route2Market
r2m.line: Put your product in front of real buyers, shelves and kitchens before you spend heavily on launch.
r2m.blurb: A challenge room with experts, then tests on shelf, in food service and with consumer panels. Foodflows launched after Route2Market.
r2m.when: When: once a working product exists. Before it: MaaS.

innoloop.title: Innoloop
innoloop.line: Chefs help you develop a product or improve a recipe.
innoloop.blurb: Professional cooks test your product in their kitchen and give honest feedback on taste and handling.
innoloop.when: When: food service is your channel. Complements MaaS and Route2Market.

eco.title: Ecosystem Map
eco.line: A map of the partners your idea needs, and warm introductions.
eco.blurb: We break your idea into value-chain roles, find candidates for each and open the first doors. We draw on about 3'000 companies, research groups and other organisations, recorded with their needs and competences, and an active network of more than 5'000 people.
eco.financing: Can be financed through Ahead (canton of Zurich) or Innosuisse innovation mentoring.

equip.title: Equipment sharing
equip.line: Save by using the network: share equipment or find it.
equip.blurb: Save costs by using the network. Members offer idle equipment or find the machine for their next trial, from lab instruments to pilot plants.

amp.title: AgrarMarktPionier
amp.line: Six months to test a farm idea on the market.
amp.blurb: Up to twelve coaching sessions and real customer conversations. The next round is planned for 2027.

nextgen.title: Next Gen
nextgen.line: We bring food innovation into upper-school classrooms.
nextgen.blurb: Lectures at upper schools on the challenges and careers of the food system.

events.title: Events
events.line: Meet the partners, buyers and researchers you need, at 30 events a year, with better terms for members.

news.title: Newsletter
news.line: Open calls, events and trends in one monthly read, and a stage that puts members' work in front of 290+ organisations.
news.blurb: Every month: calls, events and trends from the Swiss and international agro-food sector.

about.heading: Services of Swiss Food Research
about.summary: Swiss Food Research is Switzerland's neutral innovation network for agro-food and nutrition. More than 290 member organisations from startups, industry, research and the public sector work with us to turn ideas into solutions that succeed in the market.
